gripOrHq.rulesText: Search your stack for a card, and bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

gripOrHq.title: Broker
gripOrHq.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

gripOrHq.title: Clown
gripOrHq.rulesText: All ice is encountered with its strength reduced by 1.

heapOrArchives.title: Playful AI
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Roll a die. On a 1, 2, or 3, gain that many bits, set aside that many dice to roll again, or choose some combination thereof. Repeat until you have rolled all the dice you set aside.

rig.title: Cloak
rig.rulesText: Put [3] from the bank on Cloak when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Aujourd’Oui
